claims.claim: Implemented a bounded, versioned semantic proof contract with stable obligation identities, claims, acceptance coverage, provenance and explicit execution conditions independent of executable commands.

Explicit mapping validation requires independent TASK and mapping pins, validates complete declared coverage, and rejects missing, ambiguous, stale or conflicting mappings without dependency inference or PASS.
Equivalence compares semantic claims and declared subject, evidence, population, fixture, integration, profile, worker, concurrency, ordering, repetition, toolchain and environment conditions.

The contract declares candidate-first/no-reproduction behavior; base replay eligibility requires all six affirmative BR facts and compatible prerequisites. Decision helpers never request automatic reproduction or base fallback.
Added versioned frozen-TASK compatibility analysis describing scalar-list compatibility and amendment-requiring alternatives without introducing a Runtime preflight or Kernel mutation.

Added synthetic unit cases covering malformed contracts, mapping ambiguity, distinct integration obligations, every missing BR gate, decisive candidate failure, absent automatic fallback and zero-effect assertions.
The final commit changes only the three permitted paths, preserving production authoring, schedulers, profiles and historical decoding while making no cutover or VP-01 measurement claim.
